title: Predictive Translation: High-Performance Buffer Management Without the Trade-Offs
bound_sents: This offers an upper bound compared to the test-and-set latch used in Shore-MT [9], which supports latch acquisition only in exclusive mode. • A large hash table is used to eliminate collisions almost entirely. • Traditional memory pool, i.e., without predictive translation described in Section 3.
Together, these features form an upper-bound approximation of traditional buffer pool implementations like Shore-MT [1, 9], which do not utilize optimistic page latches.
